name: minecart-break-drops
comment: WP-2.4b. Three carts on the stone platform (chunks within 3 preloaded so the drops keep ticking across chunk borders): a plain cart (id 0, EntityList constructor) on a rail, a chest cart (id 1, "type": 1, EntityMinecart(world, x, y, z, 1)) on the same rail, a furnace cart (id 2, "type": 2) on the floor. Direct attack ops (target.attackEntityFrom(attacker, damage), EntityMinecart.java:73-123): the plain cart takes 1 damage at t = 2..6, +10 each, healing 1 a tick, and breaks at the fifth hit (46 > 40): setEntityDead (its cargo walk finds nothing) and one minecart item (dropItemWithOffset, the EntityItem's Math.random() draws). The chest cart takes 5 from the furnace cart as attacker and drops a minecart and a chest (its 27 empty slots walked twice, no draws). The furnace cart breaks at its third hit and drops a minecart and a furnace. Not pinned: a chest cart's cargo drop (no op fills its inventory; unit-tested in crates/mc-sim/tests/minecart_boat.rs (chest_cart_drops_its_cargo_then_walks_the_emptied_slots_again)). rng_state and entity_state every tick.
